title: Kicking
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Creative Activities; not yet checked by a CBC Creative Activities teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Use soft or improvised balls on grass. Kick to a partner, not at faces.

skills.key_step: The child names the parts of the leg used to kick, the inside-of-foot kick, and the directions of a kick.

floor.question: What do you watch when catching a ball?

steps: Kick with the inside of the foot.
contexts: a PE lesson on the field

board.do: Point to the inside of your foot.
Is this good for a short pass?
Yes, it gives an accurate kick.

misconceptions.ask: Which part of the foot gives a short, accurate kick?
misconceptions.repair: Kick to a partner with the toes and then with the inside of the foot.

misconceptions.ask: Where do you put your standing foot when you kick?
misconceptions.repair: Put a bottle top beside the ball for the standing foot.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these is used to kick a ball: the arm or the knee?
misconceptions.repair: Point to the thigh, knee, lower leg and foot while kicking slowly.

misconceptions.ask: Where do your eyes look as your foot touches the ball?
misconceptions.repair: Kick while looking away, then while watching the ball.

checks.question: Name two parts of the leg used to kick.
checks.answer: any two of: thigh, knee, lower leg, foot

checks.question: Where does your standing foot go?
